::: {#def-binary-relation}
#### Relation from one set to another

Let $A$ and $B$ be sets (@def-set).
A **relation from $A$ to $B$** [@wikipedia_binary_relation]
is a subset (@def-subset) $R$ of the Cartesian product $A \times B$ (@def-cartesian-product).
When $(a, b) \in R$, we write $a \mathrel{R} b$ and say that $a$ is related to $b$.

:::
